agent reported a spec/test contradiction:
# BLOCKED: P2.APIFB

Frozen test: `tests/flows/test_api_flow_b.py::test_order_intent_appends_one_event_and_runs_b1_only`
Spec: SPEC §10 (store layout: every Flow B run saves its audit record under `<store>/audit/<run_id>.json`), §12 (confirm = B3-B9, GET /audit/{run_id}).

## Contradiction
The test checks "no audit before the user confirms" with the LIVE filesystem, not a snapshot taken after the draft:

    assert not (scen["store"] / "audit").exists() or not list((scen["store"] / "audit").glob("*.json"))

but `scen` is a module-scoped fixture that has already run the confirm (`POST /intents/{id}/confirm`) by then, in the same
store dir (`scen["store"]` = `api_store`). SPEC §10 and the frozen test
`test_report_and_audit_of_the_confirm_run_are_served_by_run_id` require the confirm run's audit at
`scen["store"] / "audit" / f"{run_id}.json"` in that same directory. Both asserts cannot hold: once the confirm has
written its audit file, the first assert fails. (The sibling assert on `reports_after_draft` uses a snapshot taken right
after the draft; the audit assert has no such snapshot.)

## State of the implementation
`coherence_analyzer/api.py` implements everything else; all other tests in the module pass. At the order_intent POST no
audit and no report is written (verified: the only audit file in the store is the confirm run's).
The failing assert is not satisfiable by any API behaviour that also satisfies the audit test.

Needed from the oracle owner: take the snapshot of `store/audit` right after the draft (like `reports_after_draft`).
